note: Batch 2 Medium 正式候选 E-0026~E-0055（对应矩阵 §7.2 Medium 行 8 场景配额）与备选池 D-0008~D-0019。全部 gold_sql 只读、两表以内 JOIN、无子查询，针对 db/ecommerce.db（seed=20260914）固定日期口径设计，可复现。销售/金额类按规范排除 cancelled；订单数/状态分布等结构统计不排除取消。

candidates.question: 2024年及以后注册的用户数量按注册年份分布是怎样的？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', register_date) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE register_date >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY reg_year ORDER BY reg_year
candidates.notes: GROUP BY+date_group（注册年份），date_filter 2024 起。结构统计。

candidates.question: 各地区的用户数量分布是怎样的？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY region ORDER BY user_count DESC
candidates.notes: GROUP BY 单表分布（users.region 15 省级地区）。与 Easy 单地区计数不同：本题为全量分组分布。

candidates.question: 累计下单次数不少于13次的用户有哪些？（请给出用户名与订单次数）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT u.username, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.username HAVING COUNT(*) >= 13 ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.id
candidates.notes: 两表 JOIN(users×orders)+GROUP BY+HAVING。下单次数=订单结构统计（口径与 E-0012 一致，不排除取消）。

candidates.question: 按售价将商品划分为四档（低于100元、100至500元、500至2000元、2000元以上），各档分别有多少款商品？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN price < 100 THEN '低于100元' WHEN price < 500 THEN '100至500元' WHEN price < 2000 THEN '500至2000元' ELSE '2000元以上' END AS price_band, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
candidates.notes: CASE WHEN 分档 + GROUP BY 表达式 + 计数。真实价格区间 26.47~9351.34。

candidates.question: 在售商品数量超过20款的叶子分类有哪些？（请给出分类名称与在售商品数）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'on_sale' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY cnt DESC
candidates.notes: 两表 JOIN(products×categories)+WHERE(在售)+GROUP BY+HAVING。阈值 20 有真实业务分布（10 个分类）。

candidates.question: 售价低于100元的商品中，款数最多的5个分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与款数）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.price < 100 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: JOIN+WHERE 价格+GROUP BY+ORDER+LIMIT（Top-5）。低价品集中度业务分析。

candidates.question: 每个叶子分类的商品最高售价和最低售价分别是多少？（请给出分类名称、最高价与最低价）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(p.price) AS max_price, MIN(p.price) AS min_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id
candidates.notes: 两表 JOIN+GROUP BY，一题携带 MAX/MIN 双聚合。

candidates.question: 平均售价超过1500元的商品分类有哪些？（请给出分类名称与商品平均售价）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING AVG(p.price) > 1500 ORDER BY avg_price DESC
candidates.notes: JOIN+GROUP BY+HAVING（AVG 聚合阈值过滤）。结果 3 个高均价分类，业务可解释。

candidates.question: 在售商品中价格最高的5款商品是哪些？（请给出商品名称、价格与所属分类）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, p.price, c.name AS category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'on_sale' ORDER BY p.price DESC, p.id LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: 两表 JOIN+WHERE 在售+ORDER BY 倒序+LIMIT（Top-5）。ranking 场景。

candidates.question: 每个一级分类下面各有多少个子分类？（请给出一级分类名称与子分类数量）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT pc.name AS top_category, COUNT(lc.id) AS sub_count FROM categories pc JOIN categories lc ON lc.parent_id = pc.id GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name ORDER BY sub_count DESC, pc.name
candidates.notes: 分类自关联（categories×categories，单次 JOIN，非 multiple_join）+GROUP BY。层级结构分析。

candidates.question: 哪些分类下没有挂载任何商品？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(p.id) = 0 ORDER BY c.id
candidates.notes: LEFT JOIN+GROUP BY+HAVING COUNT=0（空分类检测）。结果为一组一级分类（商品只挂叶子分类），业务可解释。

candidates.question: 挂载商品数量最多的5个分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与商品数量）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: JOIN+GROUP BY+ORDER+LIMIT（Top-5）。商品 SKU 集中度分析。

candidates.question: 整个平台售价最高的商品属于哪个分类？最高价是多少？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY max_price DESC, c.id LIMIT 1
candidates.notes: JOIN+GROUP BY MAX+LIMIT 1。问题语义为 Top-1（售价最高品类的归属）。

candidates.question: 各订单状态的订单数量分别是多少？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC
candidates.notes: 订单状态结构统计（含 cancelled，口径同 E-0012/E-0013）。单表 GROUP BY。

candidates.question: 2026年实付金额超过5000元的非取消订单有多少笔？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled' AND total_amount > 5000
candidates.notes: 金额+日期+状态三条件组合过滤（orders.total_amount），时间窗与库内数据一致（截至 2026-09-12）。

candidates.question: 每个订单状态的平均实付金额是多少？（不含取消订单，按平均金额降序）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY status ORDER BY avg_amount DESC
candidates.notes: GROUP BY status + AVG(total_amount)，状态维度金额口径，正确排除 cancelled。

candidates.question: 非取消订单实付销售额最高的10个收货地区是哪些？（请给出地区名称与销售额）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
candidates.notes: GROUP BY 地区+SUM(total_amount)，排除 cancelled；TOP-10 排序。销售额口径=实付金额。

candidates.question: 2025年每个月的非取消订单实付销售额是多少？（按月份列出）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
candidates.notes: date_group（月份趋势）+SUM(total_amount)，整年窗+排除 cancelled。12 个月趋势可审计。

candidates.question: 按实付金额将非取消订单划分为三档（低于5000元、5000至20000元、20000元以上），各档分别有多少笔订单？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN total_amount < 5000 THEN '低于5000元' WHEN total_amount < 20000 THEN '5000至20000元' ELSE '20000元以上' END AS amount_tier, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
candidates.notes: CASE WHEN 金额分档+GROUP BY 表达式（订单价值分层），排除 cancelled。与 E-0024 的整窗求和相区别，避免纯时间窗模板重复。

candidates.question: 非取消订单平均实付金额（客单价）最高的5个收货地区是哪些？（请给出地区名称与平均金额）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY region ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, region LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: GROUP BY 地区+AVG(total_amount) 客单价，排除 cancelled，TOP-5。

candidates.question: 2025年发放的订单优惠（折扣）金额合计是多少？（仅统计存在优惠的订单）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND discount_amount > 0
candidates.notes: SUM(orders.discount_amount)，仅含优惠>0 订单（折扣真实发生）。促销成本口径。

candidates.question: 2024年至2026年每年的订单数量分别是多少？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year
candidates.notes: date_group（年度分组）+COUNT，跨年趋势（2024~2026 全量数据）。订单数结构统计。

candidates.question: 2026年订单数量最多的5个月份是哪几个？（请给出月份与订单数）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC, month LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: date_filter(2026)+date_group+ORDER BY+LIMIT（月份 Top-5），真实高峰月 8 月/6 月/7 月。

candidates.question: 按季度统计2024年的订单数量，每个季度各有多少笔订单？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
candidates.notes: CASE WHEN 划分季度+GROUP BY 表达式，date_group 变体。2024 全年窗。

candidates.question: 2026年工作日与周末的订单数量分别是多少？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN strftime('%w', order_date) IN ('0','6') THEN '周末' ELSE '工作日' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC, 1
candidates.notes: 工作日/周末分类聚合（strftime %w+CASE WHEN），周内消费行为分析。

candidates.question: 各收货地区的订单数量分布是怎样的？
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY order_count DESC
candidates.notes: GROUP BY orders.region 全量分布（15 地区）。订单结构统计。

candidates.question: 收货地区中，非取消订单实付销售额超过200万元的地区有哪些？（请给出地区名称与销售额）

candidates.notes: GROUP BY 地区 + HAVING SUM(total_amount) 阈值过滤（地区销售规模分层），排除 cancelled。与 E-0051 计数分布、E-0042 全量排序相区别。

candidates.question: 2026年7月至8月，订单数量最高的5个收货地区是哪些？（请给出地区名称与订单数量）

candidates.notes: 时间窗（7-8 月）+地区分组+ORDER+LIMIT（Top-5）。夏季区域性需求分布。

candidates.question: 平均售价最高的5个商品分类是哪些？（请给出分类名称与平均售价）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: JOIN+GROUP BY AVG+ORDER+LIMIT（高客单分类 Top-5）。与 E-0033（HAVING 阈值）区分。

candidates.question: 累计消费金额最高的5位用户是哪些？（请给出用户名与累计非取消实付金额）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT u.username, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id, u.username ORDER BY total_spent DESC, u.id LIMIT 5
